Shakeout iff no reclaim or >= N closes below the border before the reclaim bar. The grid's baseline 2 is the plan's declared baseline and is run as v1 (key unset, engine default null = v1's own 'more than half of the excursion window' typing, which is not a count); explicit 2 is a distinct rule and is only reached by setting the key.

Not implemented: WA2-12/WA2-18 name a lower-timeframe local Spring[C]/LPS[C] but define no entry bar, stop or target for it, and the engine walks one timeframe; building it would invent placement rules. No OPTS key is registered (no dead key). Counts toward N.

Wyckoff side only. To be decided together with ICT SCAN_WINDOW (scripts/automation.py); the coupling is not implemented here. Baseline 300 = bt.WYCKOFF_WINDOW, the live runner's window; a cell needs >= 600 bars of history.
Existing OPTS knob mgmt; no new key.

on = at least 2 recorded Phase-B tests (phase_b_tests) of EACH border third before a Spring-path structure counts.
